title: Return of the Runners
subtitle: A fan remake of Lode Runner: The Legend Returns
controls: Arrow keys: run and climb. Z / X: dig left / right. Collect all the gold to open the exit door. Trap the monks in holes.

testHint: Arrow keys: run and climb. Z / X: dig left / right. Esc: back to the editor.
